records.name: Kathleen McGurrin
records.title: Human Resources
records.quote: Paul was a key part of our Employee Development Expo. We heard such positive feedback from everyone who participated in his training sessions. I attended the Public Speaking Training and thought it was wonderful — I came away with some very useful tips. We would definitely be interested in working with Paul again, and are very interested in one of his AI Trainings.

records.name: Glenn Talavera
records.title: Director, Department of Human Resources
records.quote: I wanted to reach out to thank you for your informative presentations — we received very good feedback! We would love to set up a call to discuss a presentation to our AI committee.
